core_obligations: Item (1) (proof lines 917-923): given Gamma |- A take its finite derivation A_1, ..., A_n = A and let Gamma_0 be the lines that lie in Gamma; the same sequence is a derivation from Gamma_0.
Item (2) (lines 924-926): stated as 'the contrapositive of (1) for the special case A = falsum' - an explicit one-step derivation, both halves of the contraposition visible.
proof_roadmap: Extract the assumptions a finite proof actually mentions.
difficulty_reason: Compactness of the Hilbert-style derivability relation (statement 905-913, proof 915-927): item (1) is fully written with the finite-sequence argument; item (2) is a single displayed reduction to (1) via contraposition - the reduction line itself is present, so it reads as a completed two-part proof rather than an omission. H2: first part constructive, second part a named contrapositive instance.
